verifications.claim: Chuck Norris is a devout Christian.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Norris was a Christian and the author of several Christian-themed books. He described his faith journey as a conscious turning point that reshaped his personal priorities... He was a Baptist and a member of the Prestonwood Baptist Church..."
verifications.reasoning: The reference directly states Norris was a Christian, authored Christian-themed books, and details his faith journey and church membership, clearly supporting the claim of being devout.
